hooks.command: f="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null)"; case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt --edition 2024 "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac; exit 0
echo 'claudeconf harness, profile 3 (declared): run `lefthook run gate` before any PR. cargo test alone skips warp_core — name crates explicitly.'
